capture_source: live captures 2026-11-26 against ABAP Platform 2025 (SAP_BASIS 816, kernel 916), Unicode. 'reference' frames: pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50. 'saprfclib' frames: this library. Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP is a purpose-built remote-enabled echo module (local objects): IMPORTING IS_DEEP TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP, IS_FLAT TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT, IV_STR TYPE STRING, IT_CPLX TYPE STFCCPLXT_T, IT_RET TYPE BAPIRET2_T; EXPORTING ES_DEEP, ES_FLAT, EV_STR, ET_CPLX, ET_RET (copies of the importing values); CHANGING CS_DEEP TYPE ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP (ID incremented). ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT: C CHAR10, N NUMC6, D DATS, T TIMS, P DEC15.2, F FLTP, I1 INT1, I2 INT2, I4 INT4, I8 INT8, X RAW4, DF16 DECFLOAT16, DF34 DECFLOAT34, TS UTCLONG. ZSAPRFCLIB_DEEP: ID INT4, STR STRING, XSTR RAWSTRING, FLAT ZSAPRFCLIB_FLAT, CPLX STFCCPLXT, RETS BAPIRET2_T, CPLXT STFCCPLXT_T.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. Each .bin is one NI frame with its 4-byte length prefix.

CS_DEEP, IS_DEEP, IT_CPLX (deep rows) and IT_RET (flat rows): one 0x3c02 bracket per parameter

large_value: not stored (230 KB): the reference client sent a 2000-row IT_CPLX as 0x3c05 records of 16384 bytes each and a last one of 3857, in GW request chunks of type 0x0608
server_side: RFC server captures, 2026-11-26: destination ZSAPRFCLIB_BXML (TCP/IP, registered program, BASXML_ACTIVE='1'), called from a purpose-built module Z_SAPRFCLIB_BXML_CALL. 'S>C' here is the gateway sending the call to the registered server. Neither the reference SDK's server nor saprfclib's received the binary BXML form; both got the plain XML a client sends. The lab address is replaced by 198.51.100.9 (same length).
metadata_sequences: deep_metadata.json (Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP) and deep2_metadata.json (Z_SAPRFCLIB_DEEP2): saprfclib's metadata exchanges, server replies in order. rgsd_bapiret2_t_response.bin shows the last fallback, RFC_GET_STRUCTURE_DEFINITION, answering a table type with its line's fields.
